card.name: Link word between penicillins and cephalosporins
card.fires_on: The word 'or', 'and' or a comma right after 'penicillins' in beta-lactam allergy warnings, just before 'cephalosporins'.

modes.label: Linker after penicillins
modes.description: Or, and, or a comma following 'penicillins' in a list of beta-lactam allergy classes.

modes.label: Other antibiotic class lists
modes.description: Weaker cases inside lists of antibiotic classes, such as after 'e.g.' before a named drug.

card.writes: It suppresses 'mesh'-type tokens and mildly promotes 'finite', 'central' and 'numerical', which is unrelated to the context, so there is no clear output effect.
card.plain: It lights up on the small joining word between 'penicillins' and 'cephalosporins' in allergy cross-reactivity warnings.
